lead_fa: Restoration Shaman یک هیلی واکنشی با کیت یوتیلیتی عریض است: با [[Riptide]] HoT می‌گذاری، [[Healing Rain]] نگه می‌داری، با [[Chain Heal]] چند نفر را یکجا شفا می‌دهی و توتم‌هایی مثل [[Healing Stream Totem]] و [[Healing Tide Totem]] یا [[Tremor Totem]] و [[Poison Cleansing Totem]] برای هر موقعیت داری. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Totemic]] ساده و محکم با برچسب Best منبع، و [[Farseer]] با [[Call of the Ancestors]] که کست‌هایت را آینه می‌کند و مهارت بیشتری می‌خواهد.

strengths: Excellent utility with spells like Tremor Totem, Poison Cleansing Totem, Earthgrab Totem, Capacitor Totem, Purge and Hex
Good personal and group mobility with Ghost Wolf, Gust of Wind, Spirit Walk and Wind Rush Totem
weaknesses: Only healer without an external defensive
Strength can be a bit random due to Stormstream Totem and Deeply Rooted Elements procs
The simplicity of the kit can be a downside for players looking for deeper or more complex gameplay

buffs: Riptide instant healing increased by 25% and its heal over time by 100%
Healing Rain healing increased by 20% and it now heals 6 targets (up from 5)
Earthen Accord is now additive: Unleash Life increases your next healing ability by 45% (was effectively 30%)
Calm Waters was removed and its effect added to Current Control
Wavespeaker's Blessing moved in the tree and the new talent Swelling Tides added
Farseer: Healing Rain cooldown reduced to 12 seconds; casting a new Healing Rain cancels the old one
Farseer: Ancestors' Chain Heal improved: healing +50%, up to 5 targets (was 3), jumps reduce healing by 10% (was 30%) and max jump distance 20yds (was 15) for a total +180% healing
Farseer: Ancestors' Chain Lightning now hits up to 5 targets (was 3)
Farseer: Ancestors' Lava Burst now does more damage equal to your critical strike chance
nerfs: Totemic: Surging Totem bonus healing reduced from 20% to 10%
Totemic: Pulse Capacitor bonus healing reduced from 25% to 10%
changes_12_1.note: The 12.1 changes for Restoration Shaman are almost entirely improvements; expect to enter the new season even stronger.

hero.recommendation: Both Totemic and Farseer are close in power and perform well in any scenario; the talent page carries the Best tags for Raid, Mythic+ and Delves on Totemic. Farseer has a higher skill requirement due to the flood of Riptide charges you have to manage and the higher emphasis on target selection, while Totemic is much simpler to execute but suffers more when the group is very spread. Much of Farseer's benefit comes from spreading Riptide to more targets and more power on Riptide and Chain Heal, requiring constant attention to not overcap Riptide stacks.
hero.farseer: Augments casted abilities with effects like Maelstrom Supremacy and Windspeaker; the centerpiece is Call of the Ancestors which spawns ancestors with Unleash Life and Ancestral Swiftness that mimic your casts. Riptide becomes more available via Offering from Beyond and Mystic Knowledge.
hero.totemic: Centered on making totems more powerful and accessible; its active ability Surging Totem gives a much less restrictive way of controlling Healing Rain, with nodes like Lively Totems and Splitstream.
hero.comparison_source_note: Wowhead talent page (updated 2026-10-13): Totemic carries the Best tags for Raid, Mythic+ and Delves; both trees are close in power.

builds.notes: Totemic is simpler to execute and carries the Best tags; Farseer is close in power with a higher skill requirement: managing the flood of Riptide charges and heavier target selection, in exchange for spreading Riptide to more targets and more power on Riptide and Chain Heal.

concepts: Pick your targets correctly: Undercurrent, Deluge, Flow of the Tides and Tidewaters benefit from as many Riptides active as possible; Mastery: Deep Healing rewards healing the lowest-health players

Use your short cooldowns on cooldown: Unleash Life, Healing Rain, Surging Totem, Downpour, Nature's Swiftness, Ancestral Swiftness and Healing Stream Totem with its Stormstream Totem procs are most valuable pressed early and often

Manage your mana: Healing Wave is cheap single-target filler while Chain Heal is expensive but spreads healing; talents like Resurgence and Current Control alleviate mana issues at the cost of other alternatives
A very straightforward spec: maximize value from short cooldowns and pick Riptide and filler targets well
raid_priority: Use all your Stormstream Totem procs
Keep Healing Stream Totem on cooldown
Cast Chain Heal or Healing Wave
farseer_raid_priority: Use all your Stormstream Totem procs
Keep Healing Stream Totem on cooldown
Cast Chain Heal or Healing Wave
mplus_priority: Same priority as raid: Stormstream Totem procs, Riptide on cooldown, Nature's Swiftness (Totemic) or Ancestral Swiftness + Unleash Life (Farseer), Surging Totem or Healing Rain maintenance, Healing Stream Totem on cooldown
Spot healing matters more than mana: pick Chain Heal or Healing Wave by who needs healing most, not by resources
Healing Rain is harder to get value from with fewer players but is still worth it for effects like Deluge as long as a majority of the group stands inside it
rotation.aoe_note: Chain Heal is considerably stronger but costs significantly more mana; Healing Wave is very good and very cheap. Use Chain Heal as much as mana allows when AoE healing is needed and Healing Wave for single-target healing or mana conservation.

cooldowns.Stormstream Totem: One of your biggest healing sources; the vast majority of procs come from Nature's Swiftness (Totemic) or Ancestral Swiftness (Farseer); the buff lasts 60 seconds and you can hold up to 2 stacks, but delaying costs Healing Stream Totem casts
cooldowns.Ascendance: During it Chain Heal and Healing Wave become much stronger; prepare with 2 stacks of Tidal Waves by using all Riptides and cast Surging Totem right before pressing the cooldown; inside it use all available Healing Stream Totems and Stormstream Totems since they cast instant free Chain Heals
cooldowns.Healing Stream Totem: Keep on cooldown; it is cheap and constant value, and skipping casts while holding Stormstream procs is the main mistake

rotation.hero_notes: Totemic maintains Surging Totem and plays Nature's Swiftness; Farseer plays Ancestral Swiftness and Unleash Life while maintaining Healing Rain, with Stormstream procs mostly coming from Ancestral Swiftness.
pre_combat: Buff yourself: Water Shield, Earth Shield and Earthliving Weapon should always be active (Instinctive Imbuements helps; Therazane's Resilience makes them hourly unless you die)
Cast group buffs: Skyfury on the whole group and make sure someone carries your second Earth Shield
Do not forget consumables: food and flasks, Vantus and Augment runes, and bring water to restore mana out of combat

gear.gearing_rules: Intellect is the most important stat; for secondaries get as much Critical Strike as possible, then Haste and Versatility of similar value with Mastery last. Crit is the strongest secondary in all situations thanks to Resurgence, White Water and Ancestral Awakening. Haste's value varies with mana handling and it synergizes with the tier set 2pc (more Haste spawns more Healing Rains that tick faster); Versatility is a more passive and consistent value. Your best gear includes two crafted items with embellishments which vary during the season. Sim with Raidbots.

stats.cheatsheet: Intellect > Critical Strike > Haste ~= Versatility > Mastery; identical for Farseer and Totemic.
notes: Critical Strike is the strongest secondary in all situations due to Resurgence, White Water and Ancestral Awakening.
Haste makes you spend more mana but scales a lot of your healing and synergizes with the tier set 2pc by spawning more, faster-ticking Healing Rains.
Versatility offers a more passive and consistent increase; it makes mana last longer on longer fights.
Resurgence scales with maximum mana, so mana-increasing effects like Primordial Capacity multiply with each other.

mplus.hero_note: Totemic carries the Best tags for Mythic+ this season and is much simpler to execute; Farseer is close in power but demands constant Riptide management. Mana is usually less of a concern in dungeons and spot healing matters more.
tips: Pick Chain Heal or Healing Wave by who needs healing most, not by mana
Keep Riptide rolling on cooldown and spread it to allies without it for Undercurrent, Deluge, Flow of the Tides and Tidewaters value
Use all Stormstream Totem procs as soon as possible to avoid missing Healing Stream Totem casts
Healing Rain is still worth maintaining for Deluge as long as a majority of the group stands inside it
Use your totem utility (Tremor Totem, Poison Cleansing Totem, Capacitor Totem) proactively for dungeon mechanics
